lines: Baat niklegi to phir door talak jayegi
Log bewajah udaasi ka sabab poochhenge
couplets.en: Once word gets out, it will travel far, and people will ask for no reason what makes you sad.

lines: Ye bhi poochhenge ke tum itni pareshaan kyun ho
couplets.en: They will ask, too, why you are so troubled.

lines: Ungliyan uthengi sookhe hue baalon ki taraf
Ek nazar dekhenge guzre hue saalon ki taraf
couplets.en: Fingers will point at your dry hair, and someone will cast a glance back at the years gone by.

lines: Joodon par bhi kai tanz kiye jayenge
Kaanpte haathon pe bhi fiqre kase jayenge
couplets.en: They will mock the way you pin up your hair and make jibes at your trembling hands.

lines: Log zaalim hain, har ek baat ka taana denge
Baaton baaton mein mera zikr bhi le aayenge
couplets.en: People are cruel, and they will find a taunt in everything and slip my name into the conversation.

lines: Baaton baaton mein mera zikr bhi le aayenge
couplets.en: In the course of talking, they will bring me up too.

lines: Unki baaton ka zara sa bhi asar mat lena
Warna chehre ke taassur se samajh jayenge
couplets.en: Let none of their words get to you, or they will read it in your face.

lines: Chaahe kuchh bhi ho, sawaalaat na karna unse
Chaahe kuchh bhi ho, sawaalaat na karna unse
Mere baare mein koi baat na karna unse
couplets.en: Whatever happens, ask them no questions and say nothing to them about me.

lines: Baat niklegi to phir door talak jayegi
couplets.en: Once word gets out, it will travel far.
